init.android: Call KickBootstrap.init(...) during app startup (Application.onCreate or equivalent).

hook.firebaseCloudMessagingIos: When APNS notification is received, call one of Kick.firebaseCloudMessaging.handleApns... handlers from shared Kotlin API bridge.
hook.firebaseAnalytics: Mirror analytics wrapper calls to Kick.firebaseAnalytics.logEvent / setUserId / setUserProperty.

analytics.title: Firebase Analytics quick setup
analytics.subtitle: Follow these steps in order. Do exactly this and integration will be consistent.
analytics.step2: In logEvent(...), call Firebase SDK first, then call Kick.firebaseAnalytics.logEvent(name, params).
analytics.step3: In setUserId(...), call Firebase SDK first, then call Kick.firebaseAnalytics.setUserId(id).
analytics.step4: In setUserProperty(...), call Firebase SDK first, then call Kick.firebaseAnalytics.setUserProperty(name, value).
analytics.step5: Replace direct Firebase calls with this wrapper everywhere in the app.

guide.title: What to wire in your app code
guide.subtitle: Follow these steps. Only relevant items are shown for your selected modules.
guide.logging: To send logs to Logging module, call Kick.log(level, message) in the places you want to log.
guide.loggingWithNapier: To send logs to Logging module, call Kick.log(level, message) where needed, or route all Napier logs with installNapierBridge() from KickBootstrap.
guide.ktor3: To log Ktor3 network activity, add install(KickKtor3Plugin) when you create HttpClient.
guide.firebaseCloudMessagingBoth: For Firebase Cloud Messaging: on Android call Kick.firebaseCloudMessaging.handleFcm(message) inside FirebaseMessagingService.onMessageReceived(...). On iOS call KickCompanion.shared.firebaseCloudMessaging.handleApnsPayload(userInfo: userInfo) in AppDelegate when APNS payload is received.
guide.firebaseCloudMessagingAndroid: For Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android: call Kick.firebaseCloudMessaging.handleFcm(message) inside FirebaseMessagingService.onMessageReceived(...).
guide.firebaseCloudMessagingIos: For Firebase Cloud Messaging on iOS: call KickCompanion.shared.firebaseCloudMessaging.handleApnsPayload(userInfo: userInfo) in AppDelegate when APNS payload is received.
guide.firebaseCloudMessagingGeneric: For Firebase Cloud Messaging, forward push payloads to Kick handlers in your platform lifecycle code.
guide.firebaseAnalytics: For Firebase Analytics, add Kick.firebaseAnalytics.logEvent(...), Kick.firebaseAnalytics.setUserId(...), and Kick.firebaseAnalytics.setUserProperty(...) in matching places in your analytics wrapper.
guide.controlPanel: Read ControlPanel values in your code with Kick.controlPanel.getBoolean(...), Kick.controlPanel.getString(...), etc. If you added buttons, listen for clicks with Kick.controlPanel.events.collect { event -> ... }.
guide.overlay: Show required runtime values in Overlay floating window with Kick.overlay.set("key", value).
guide.runner: Register useful debug actions in the places you need with Kick.runner.addCall(...).
